notes.title: ANNOUNCEMENT: We need your support! (Kickstarter)
notes.content:
[h1]ANNOUNCEMENT: Crowdfunding[/h1]

[b]The Kickstarter for Somber Heaven is now LIVE![/b] 
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/nikoskipz/somber-heaven-open-world-action-rpg?ref=user_menu
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45369155/ce764487476645d80d13336bf6943412680e1b9d.png[/img]

I'm asking for your support! if you can, please support and back this project. This project has been an absolute dream of mine ever since I was a kid.. I'm so excited and happy to finally have the opportunity to work on this, and we won't be able to do it without this extra bit of funding.. 

[b]I will be needed these for Somber Heaven's Development:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]PC Upgrades:[/b] Graphics Card with a lot of VRAM to develop the open world, bigger power supply to handle  the new GPU and multiple screens for multi-tasking
[*] [b]Motion Capture Suit:[/b] Somber Heaven will have a bunch of animations, ranging from Movement, Combat to Cutscenes. All of this will be impossible to do without a motion capture suit.
[*] [b]Music Equipment:[/b] Better music equipment means easier music production and better music! 
[*] [b]Voice Actors:[/b] Sonara is a big world, and it should be a world that has a voice. I'll be putting up out of my own pocket for VA's but with crowdfunding that'll help keep the costs a lot lower.
[/list]

and with Kickstarter (and your help!), all of that will become a reality!

If you've already backed the project, I just want to give you a HUGE thank you from the bottom of my heart! If you're thinking about backing the project..

You can back the project on kickstarter right here:
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/nikoskipz/somber-heaven-open-world-action-rpg?ref=user_menu
